name: Freemans Pro 5m Carbon Steel Measuring Tape with Auto-Lock
shortDescription: ISI-certified 5m x 19mm nylon-coated carbon steel measuring tape with automatic blade lock, magnetic dual hook, and shock-absorbing rubberized casing.
overview: The Freemans Pro 5-Meter measuring tape is an indispensable layout and surveying tool for civil contractors, mechanical engineers, and carpenters. Manufactured from high-tensile carbon steel, the 19mm wide curved blade is protected by an abrasion-resistant Dura-Coat nylon polymer film that shields graduations from scratching, moisture, and site dirt. Featuring an intelligent auto-lock mechanism that automatically holds the blade firmly at any extended length until the bottom release paddle is pressed, it enables effortless single-handed measurements.
keyFeatures: Heavy-gauge 19mm wide carbon steel blade extends with standout exceeding 2.2 meters
Dura-Coat nylon clear wrap provides up to 5x greater wear and scratch resistance
Smooth Auto-Lock mechanism automatically grips the blade upon extension
Magnetic dual-catch true zero end hook provides positive hold on steel beams and pipes
Clear high-contrast metric and imperial graduations certified to Class II accuracy
High-impact ABS case wrapped in a non-slip textured TPR rubber shock-absorbing jacket
Fitted with heavy-duty metal belt clip and durable wrist lanyard
